public_rationale: A June 3, 2023 paper demonstrated training-data influence analysis using specially trained diffusion-model ensembles [e1]. GitHub's November 30, 2023 update described a Copilot public beta that provided references to matching public code [e2]. These demonstrations do not establish reliable training-source attribution in generative AI systems deployed by December 29, 2023 [e1, e2]. Neither establishes that technical inability explains missing attribution, so the causal claim remains unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: The research demonstration does not establish reliable attribution in contemporary deployed systems [e1].
Code matching identifies similar material without proving which training sources influenced an output [e2].
Neither item establishes why training-source attribution was absent across the claimed systems [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current generative AI systems do not attribute source materials because, as currently built (black boxes), they cannot.

statement.excerpt: GenAI systems don’t give attribution to source materials because at least as constituted now, they can’t.
statement.document_title: Things are about to get a lot worse for Generative AI

from_speaker: don’t give attribution to source materials
at least as constituted now, they can’t
our_interpretation: In this discussion of training materials and provenance, attribution means reliably identifying the training sources behind an output. Merely citing a retrieved webpage or labeling an image AI-generated does not establish that capability.
The claim asserts that technical inability explains missing attribution. Missing product features alone cannot establish that cause.
A limited research demonstration or matching service bears against an absolute impossibility claim, but does not necessarily establish reliable attribution in deployed systems.
criteria.support_condition: Technical evidence establishes that contemporary deployed systems could not reliably identify the training sources behind their outputs, and that this limitation explains their failure to provide attribution.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporary deployed system demonstrably provides reliable training-source attribution, or technical evidence establishes that the claimed inability was not the reason attribution was absent.

evidence.explanation: The researchers proposed specially trained ensembles that permit analysis of training-data influence. This limits a sweeping impossibility argument, but does not demonstrate reliable attribution in the deployed DALL-E or ChatGPT systems.
